Serious adverse reactions in 5% of subjects included pancreatitis and cholecystitis. Warnings include serious encapsulated bacterial infections, hepatic enzyme increases, and hyperlipidemia.

detail.text: Serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria (Neisseria meningitidis, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae type B), which may become rapidly life-threatening or fatal; vaccination required and available only through the VOYDEYA REMS.

citations.quote: VOYDEYA, a complement inhibitor, increases the risk of serious infections, especially those caused by encapsulated bacteria, such as *Neisseria meningitidis*, *Streptococcus pneumoniae*, and *Haemophilus influenzae* type B [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)]. Life-threatening and fatal infections with encapsulated bacteria have occurred in patients treated with complement inhibitors. These infections may become rapidly life-threatening or fatal if not recognized and treated early.

detail.text: VOYDEYA REMS — a restricted program with elements to assure safe use because of the risk of serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria; prescribers and pharmacies must be certified.

citations.quote: VOYDEYA is available only through a restricted program under a REMS called VOYDEYA REMS, because of the risk of serious infections caused by encapsulated bacteria [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)].

requirement.text: 4601-1 Establish a registry to characterize the long-term safety of danicopan in adults with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH), with at least 5 years of follow-up. Yearly safety follow-up data should include a summary of the major safety findings for all patients and all serious infections with encapsulated bacteria. The final study report should include an integrated safety dataset and patient level data, including data on danicopan dosing, meningococcal and pneumococcal vaccination status, and concomitant medications.
